newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE BEATS OLAZABAL DESPITE WAYWARD PUTTER.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE BEATS OLAZABAL DESPITE WAYWARD PUTTER.

text.p: European number one Colin Montgomerie was again woeful with the putter but too good from tee to green for Jose Maria Olazabal in the Andersen Consulting world championship regional competition on Monday.
Olazabal, invited into the eight-player field because of his 18 months injury absence, lost two and one.
Darren Clarke of Britain provided the upset of the opening matches by defeating Bernhard Langer two and one.
Costantino Rocca edged out Jesper Parnevik at the 20th after the Swede had battled back from three down with five to play.
Sam Torrance, who earned a crack at the $1 million first prize in the four-player finale in the United States last year, overcame Ian Woosnam four and three.
Torrrance eliminated Montgomerie in last year's European final and meets him in the semifinals on Tuesday.

"My putting has slumped to a new level," said Montgomerie after missing a string of chances inside 10 feet. "I never knew it could get as low as it has.s practice, practice and I will be hitting another 300 balls on the green again tonight."
Torrance sank several long putts with his broom-handled putter, which he fears may soon be outlawed, but the key to winning came with a chip-in eagle on the long 11th.
Clarke's superior back nine gave him victory over Langer.
Parnevik showed battling qualities to finish all square on the 18th, but a shot into water on the second extra hole ended his hopes.
